audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read "Skill" on rows 0-5 while the content layer and the packet both read Lux, Lux, Skill, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia. Rows 3-5 also had whys describing Lux winning.
audit.why: Lux's Q is 1175 and E 1100 against Cassiopeia's 850 Q and 700 W/E, so levels 1-2 are hers; once the poison ramp and Twin Fang (0.75s) are online, Cassiopeia grinds down anything that stands still.

audit.why: Final Spark drops to a 40-second cooldown at rank 3 and reaches 3340 units — once lane spacing is gone it is her only tool that outranges Cassiopeia's entire kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Miasma's grounding as the thing to fear, and never mentions that Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia. The missing-interactions file flags exactly that: her chip-damage sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: Lux has no dash or leap, so Miasma's grounding does nothing to her — the slow is the real threat. Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that heals for a percentage of damage dealt, so any extended trade goes to Cassiopeia without anti-heal. Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s and Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80s.
